fullPassage: One well-known shift took place when the accepted view — that the Earth was the center of the universe — changed to one where we understood that we are only inhabitants on one planet orbiting the Sun. With each person who grasped the solar system view, it became easier for the next person to do so. So it is with the notion that the world revolves around the human economy. This is slowly being replaced by the view that the economy is a part of the larger system of material flows that connect all living things. When this perspective shifts into place, it will be obvious that our economic well-being requires that we account for, and respond to, factors of ecological health. Unfortunately we do not have a century or two to make the change. By clarifying the nature of the old and new perspectives, and by identifying actions on which we might cooperate to move the process along, we can help accelerate the shift.

ch: 지구 중심설은 끝까지 모든 사람에게 받아들여진 채로 남았다.
글쓴이는 인간 경제 중심의 관점이 점점 강화되고 있다고 본다.
한 사람이 태양계 관점을 이해하면 다음 사람은 더 쉽게 이해했다.
글쓴이는 변화를 이룰 시간이 넉넉하다고 말한다.

questions.passage: One well-known shift took place when the accepted view — that the Earth was the center of the universe — changed to one where we understood that we are only inhabitants on one planet orbiting the Sun. With each person who grasped the solar system view, it became easier for the next person to do so. So it is with the notion that the world revolves around the human economy. This is slowly being replaced by the view that the economy is a part of the larger system of material flows that connect all living things. When this perspective shifts into place, it will be obvious that our economic well-being requires that we account for, and respond to, factors of ecological health. Unfortunately we do not have a century or two to make the change. By clarifying the nature of the old and new perspectives, and by identifying actions on which we might cooperate to move the process along, we can help accelerate the shift.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① 'the economy is a part of the larger system of material flows that connect all living things'와 일치해요.

✅ ③ 'By clarifying the nature ... we can help accelerate the shift'와 일치해요.

det.tip: 불일치 문제는 속도·정도를 뒤집은 선지를 조심 (slowly ↔ very fast)

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]에 맞게 영작하시오. (영어로)

"이것은 그 관점에 의해 천천히 대체되고 있다."

[조건] (1) being, by, is, replaced, slowly, the, this, view를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 현재진행 수동태: is being + p.p. = ~되고 있다. this + is + slowly + being + replaced + by + the + view
det.analysis:
'대체되고 있다'는 지금 진행 중인 수동의 뜻이라 현재진행 수동태 'is being + 과거분사'로 써요.

① 주어는 this(이것), 동사 뼈대는 'is being replaced(대체되고 있다)'예요.

② 부사 slowly(천천히)는 is와 being 사이에 넣어 'is slowly being replaced'로 만들어요.

③ '그 관점에 의해'는 행위자를 나타내는 by the view로 마무리해요.

순서대로: this is slowly being replaced by the view (8단어)
det.tip: 현재진행 수동태 = is/are being + 과거분사(p.p.): is being replaced(대체되고 있다)
